name: kotlin-testing
description: Writes, runs, debugs and fixes JVM-local Kotlin tests with kotlin.test, JUnit, Kotest, MockK, kotlinx-coroutines-test and Turbine. Use whenever editing or debugging Kotlin test code (*Test.kt, src/test/kotlin): UncompletedCoroutinesError or a runTest that hangs for 1m, tests slowed by delay, Dispatchers.setMain and a MainDispatcherRule, "Module with the Main dispatcher is missing", testing a ViewModel, StateFlow, SharedFlow or Channel events with Turbine, MockK "no answer found for", coEvery versus every, relaxed mocks, confirmVerified, Kotest spec styles, and running one test with ./gradlew :module:test --tests.
